name: Malek Bennabi
contribution: An Algerian writer and philosopher, of Islamic, Salafist and Wahhabi inspiration who wrote about human society, particularly Muslim society with a focus on the reasons behind the fall of Muslim civilization and the keys for Renaissance.
legacy: In studying many civilizations throughout the written history, this person concludes that every civilization starts with a moral system which usually has its roots in some religious foundation.

checks.lead: Malek Bennabi (1 January 1905 – 31 October 1973) (Arabic: مالك بن نبي, romanized: Malik ibn Nabī) was an Algerian writer and philosopher, of Islamic, Salafist and Wahhabi inspiration who wrote about human society, particularly Muslim society with a focus on the reasons behind the fall of Muslim civilization and the keys for Renaissance.
